How to Download a YouTube Thumbnail

Four steps to grab any YouTube thumbnail. No account. No software. Works on any device.

1
Copy the URL
Go to any YouTube video and copy the link from your browser's address bar or the Share button.
2
Paste & Search
Paste the link into the search bar above and click Get Thumbnails.
3
Download Your Size
Hover over any thumbnail card and click Download to save the image directly.
4
Pick a Resolution
We show every available size, from Max HD (1280×720) down to compact. Max HD is the best quality.
Recreate a Competitor's Thumbnail

Download their thumbnail, then use this AI prompt to get a full JSON recreation guide in Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI tool.

Step 1: Download a competitor's thumbnail using the tool above.

Step 2: Upload that image into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.

Step 3: Paste this prompt alongside it and copy the JSON it gives you:

Give me a full JSON prompt to recreate this exact image perfectly. Include: primary subject and their appearance, background colors and textures, text overlays (exact wording, font style, size, color, position), facial expressions and emotions, lighting direction and style, color palette (hex codes if possible), composition and layout, any graphic elements or effects, and overall mood/tone. Format everything as clean JSON so I can hand it directly to an image generation model.

Step 4: Take the JSON output and paste it into a text-to-image generator (Midjourney, DALL·E, Ideogram, Firefly, etc.) to recreate the thumbnail.

Frequently Asked Questions
Everything you need to know about downloading YouTube thumbnails

Paste any YouTube video URL into the search bar above and click Get Thumbnails. Every available resolution appears instantly, hover over any card and click Download. No login, no account, no watermark required.

The highest quality is Max HD at 1280×720 pixels. This is only available for videos where the creator uploaded a custom thumbnail. If Max HD isn't available, the next best is Standard (640×480), followed by High Quality (480×360). Thumbnail Swiper automatically checks and shows every size that exists.

Yes. Thumbnail Swiper supports all YouTube URL formats including Shorts (youtube.com/shorts/), standard watch links (youtube.com/watch?v=), short links (youtu.be/), and embedded video URLs. Just paste the URL and it works.

Thumbnails are publicly accessible images on YouTube's servers. Downloading them for personal research, design inspiration, or competitive analysis is generally accepted. You should not redistribute another creator's thumbnail commercially or claim it as your own. Always respect intellectual property rights.

Yes, Thumbnail Swiper is fully responsive and works on iPhone, Android, and all tablets. Open the site in Safari or Chrome, paste the YouTube URL, and tap Get Thumbnails. The image downloads directly to your Photos or Downloads folder.

Max HD (1280×720) is only generated when a creator uploads a custom thumbnail to their video. Older videos or videos using an auto-generated screenshot instead of a custom thumbnail will only have High Quality (480×360) available. Thumbnail Swiper automatically detects which sizes exist and only shows the ones available.

No account, no login, no sign-up required. Paste a URL, download a thumbnail. That's it. There is also no limit on how many thumbnails you can download.

Beyond downloading thumbnails, Thumbnail Swiper lets you preview your thumbnail on a realistic YouTube home feed mockup, split-test up to three thumbnail designs side by side, and recreate competitor thumbnails using an AI prompt generator, all free, all in one place.

About Us

Thumbnail Swiper, Built for YouTube Creators

Thumbnail Swiper is a free, no-login toolkit built for YouTube creators who take their thumbnails seriously. Everything runs in your browser, fast, private, and always free.

We noticed that the tools creators actually needed, downloading thumbnails, previewing how they look on YouTube, split-testing ideas, and reverse-engineering competitor designs, were either paywalled, or just didn't exist. So we built them all in one clean, fast, free tool.

Privacy Policy

Effective date: June 2026

The short version: Thumbnail Swiper does not directly collect personal information through the tool. Third-party services like Google AdSense may use cookies for ad personalization. See Section 4 for details on how to opt out.

1. Who We Are

Thumbnail Swiper is a free online tool that allows users to download YouTube video thumbnails and access related creator utilities. This policy explains our approach to your privacy.

2. Information We Currently Collect

As of the effective date of this policy, Thumbnail Swiper does not directly collect personal information through the tool itself. However, third-party services we use (such as Google AdSense) may collect certain data automatically. We do not currently collect or store:

  • Your name, email address, or any personal identifiers
  • YouTube URLs you paste into the tool
  • Images you upload for the preview or split-test features
  • Your IP address or location data directly
  • Browser fingerprints or device information directly

This may change in the future. If we begin collecting additional data, this policy will be updated accordingly.

3. How the Tool Works

Core functionality, thumbnail fetching, image preview, split testing, and prompt copying, is designed to run in your browser. When you paste a YouTube URL, your browser retrieves the thumbnail directly from YouTube's public servers (i.ytimg.com). We do not intentionally store or log the content of your searches. Third-party services embedded in the site (such as advertising networks) may operate independently and are subject to their own privacy policies.

4. Third-Party Services & Advertising

Thumbnail images are fetched from YouTube's public CDN (ytimg.com), which is operated by Google. Your use of YouTube content is subject to Google's Privacy Policy. We have no control over and no visibility into those requests.

Google AdSense: Thumbnail Swiper may use Google AdSense to display advertisements. Google AdSense is a third-party advertising service operated by Google LLC. Google and its partners may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this site or other sites on the internet. These cookies allow Google and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to Thumbnail Swiper and/or other sites on the internet.

You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings, or by visiting aboutads.info to opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising.

For more information on how Google uses data when you use our site, visit google.com/policies/privacy/partners.

5. Children's Privacy

Thumbnail Swiper is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect any information from children.

6. Changes to This Policy

If this policy changes materially, we will update the effective date above. Continued use of Thumbnail Swiper after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

7. Contact

Questions about this privacy policy? Since we collect no user data, there is no account system or data request process. For general inquiries, use the Contact link in the footer of this site.
